review_reference: The services as deployed now, after backend release backend-41333594692-1-124c45a5cdf6c1c7 (D-Eminence/hid-system#141 at 6c6fc18, which released the pharmacy guard from hid-system#139). That release rebuilt and deployed every service at 6c6fc18, because #141 changed scripts/, so every service pins to 6c6fc18. Browser-facing changes since the previous pins (82f52b9): pharmacy-api refuses a same-facility acceptance that is not exactly its active EHR prescription (404 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND, 409 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_NOT_ACTIVE, 409 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH, 422 PRESCRIPTION_SOURCE_MISMATCH) and a dispensing whose prescription has changed (409 PHARMACY_PRESCRIPTION_NOT_DISPENSABLE); this frontend shows its general refusal for these until the pharmacy reload mapping ships. ehr-api sends a prescription's startsOn and endsOn as calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD) instead of timestamps, which every formatter here already reads (calendarDate, calendarDay); a send to another facility now runs SERIALIZABLE with retry, with no change in shape. gateway, identity-api, lab-api, ocr-api, outreach-api, support-api and notification-api have no code change since 82f52b9. Nothing else this frontend calls changed shape. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-11-01 ("Approve re-pin", for re-pinning the website after the pharmacy guard release so the five urgent EHR fixes, health#104, can release).
